text: I The Lord is king; let the earth rejoice;let the many islands be glad. [AA]
Cloud and darkness surround him;justice and right are the foundation of his throne. [AB]
Fire goes before him,consuming his foes on every side.
His lightening illumines the world;the earth sees and trembles. [AC]
The mountains melt like wax before the Lord,before the Lord of all the earth. [AD]
The heavens proclaim his justice;all peoples see his glory. [AE]
II All who serve idols are put to shame,who glory in worthless things;all gods [1] bow down before him. [AF]
Zion hears and is glad,and the daughters of Judah rejoicebecause of your judgments, O Lord. [AG]
For you, Lord, are the Most High over all the earth, [AH]exalted far above all gods.
You who love the Lord, hate evil,he protects the souls of the faithful, [AI]rescues them from the hand of the wicked.
Light dawns for the just,and gladness for the honest of heart. [AJ]
Rejoice in the Lord, you just,and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. [AK]
